title: GC18R Transactional Groundwater Exchange Postimage Architecture Audit

invariants.basis: reconciliation preserves the one shared SWAP kernel and adds no alternate use-case kernel
no kernel I/O, file-format, path, parser or file-unit dependency is introduced
the admitted typed separation of checkpoint, candidate, prepared reservation and result data is unchanged
no persistent per-column state is added; preparable reservation state remains optional and pooled
no Newton, Jacobian or constitutive scratch ownership changes
no storage-layout or batching constraint is introduced; admitted O(1) free-list reservation management is preserved
checkpoint, trial, retry, commit and rollback semantics plus stale-handle publication guards remain byte-identical
failed prepare/abort continue to preserve committed origin state and permit correct retry
generic t0,t1 time contracts remain unchanged with no day, month, year or midnight assumption
no fixed coupling-window duration is introduced
the already admitted transactional groundwater exchange runtime capability is preserved without scope expansion
F-GC17 typed groundwater contract remains byte-identical, including q_GW=-q_SWAP and residual convention
no water-balance tolerance is added and exactly-once transaction publication protection is preserved
interface sensitivity and response-tangent contracts are untouched
no extra full SWAP coupling trajectories or structural coupling cost are introduced
MultiSWAP-compatible pooled optional reservation state is preserved; no per-column heavy solver instance is added
no one-to-one SWAP to MODFLOW cell relationship is encoded
deep-vadose component ownership remains outside SWAP and untouched
component-transition storage/accounting is untouched and duplicate committed publication remains prevented
groundwater exchange remains independent of any particular soil-water solver implementation
crop, ET, drainage, irrigation and surface-process implementations are not duplicated or changed
no HeadCalc internal arrays or numerical implementation details are exposed
transaction-safety runtime behavior remains separate from physical configuration
fail-closed revision exhaustion, stale-prepared rejection and bounded reservation lookup remain preserved
reference mode and reference tree are byte-identical to the admitted postimage
transaction statuses and failure modes remain explicit and diagnosable; reconciliation adds no hidden path
optional preparable-service reservation cost remains lazy and proportional to active use
runtime/coupler retains system composition; reconciliation encodes no tile, MODFLOW or transfer-zone ownership
no file, calendar, MODFLOW, revision-headroom, backend-one-shot or moving-preservation assumption is introduced
F-CI53P explicitly rechecks all 30 invariants and preserves owner, independent, source-admission and broad-postimage authorities

hard_nonclaims: No new physics, science, solver behavior or scientific tolerance is introduced.
No MODFLOW adapter, aquifer solver or physical groundwater response model is admitted.
No end-to-end production coupling or full predictor-corrector convergence is claimed.
No process-crash recovery or distributed transaction protocol is claimed.
No large-batch throughput qualification is claimed.
No production, reference or canonical moving-preservation mutation is made by F-CI53P.
